about: A navigation typed in the chat, as the game's help on navigation writes it ("/navi prontera 100 100"): /navi prontera 150 150 in Prontera starts a navigation to that cell (the arrow over the player, the trail on the minimap) with the Navigation window open; /navi2 with a cell and flags does the same; a map the navigation tables don't have gets the client's "That does not support the navigation area"; a bare /navi still just opens or closes the window.

expect.chat: That does not support the navigation area
